understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to move every selectable piece onto a corresponding goal tile marked '+'. A level is completed only when all goal tiles are occupied simultaneously, and completing all levels wins the game.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Pieces could be selected or repositioned with CLICK using grid coordinates, while directional moves attempted to move the currently selected piece. Walls and obstacles blocked movement, producing no position change; some clicks also had no effect when the target was blocked or inaccessible. Efficient planning was necessary because each level had a finite step budget.
